item.title: Imperialism is the primary contradiction, but it is not the singular contradiction - and to effectively move in this political e...
item.description:
Imperialism is the primary contradiction, but it is not the singular contradiction - and to effectively move in this political environment especially when liberals insist upon hyper focusing and singularly focusing on electoral politics we must understand so we can undermine precisely those internal contradictions and the way they are leverage to justify the primary contradiction. Put simply the difference between the parties is how they do imperialism, absolutely. But in many context, they give meaningfully different answers, that if we are to beat the imperialism they engage in we must understand.
